text.en: Spectrum: block size and window; each map column is one block.
text.cs: Spectrum: velikost bloku a okno; každý sloupec mapy je jeden blok.

text.en: View: Linear, Power or PSD, RMS or Peak, colour scale Linear or dB (Log); redraws without recomputing.
text.cs: View: Linear, Power nebo PSD, RMS nebo Peak, barevná škála Linear nebo dB (Log); jen překreslí.

text.en: Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (axis in rpm) or Free Run (axis in time), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.
text.cs: Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (osa v rpm) nebo Free Run (osa v čase), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.

text.en: The map: frequency across, speed or time along, colour is the amplitude. A line is a tone, a bright patch a resonance.
text.cs: Mapa: frekvence napříč, otáčky nebo čas podél, barva je amplituda. Čára je tón, světlá skvrna rezonance.
